::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Infineon's Bengaluru centre is a core design hub for power management and automotive microcontroller development.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Power MOSFETs, IGBT modules, AURIX automotive microcontrollers, OPTIGA security chips, and PSoC connectivity solutions.
